name: Mochizuki Nadeshiko
source:
The owner of a local pet store. 
Despite her incredibly young appearance, she is actually older than Yuuichi, which has made lots of people confused about her, Yuuichi included. 
Initially helps Yuuichi with Mikan and Silvie.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanko_to_Kurasō]Wikipedia[/url]]
